title: I Built an Open Source AI Research Agent
description:
The model was never the problem. Same model, same prompt, no agent = a wall  of outdated text.

So I gave it the missing pieces: an MCP server for live web search, a skill that teaches it to build a real report, a sandbox to run code safely, and subagents that split the research three ways in parallel.

Runs on TrueForge — open source, any model, free, one command to start.

#AIAgents #OpenSource #MCP
